transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Leonardo express connects Fiumicino Airport with Roma Termini non-stop in 32 minutes, with departures scheduled every 15 minutes. The railway station is inside the airport. A ticket costs €14; the Mini-groups fare lets you buy 4 tickets in one transaction for €40 instead of €56.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Left luggage is in the international arrivals area of Terminal 3 near the bus station and is open from 07:00 to 23:00. The price is €10 including VAT per piece of baggage per 24 hours. Payment is made when collecting the baggage; no advance reservation is required.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: The airport has more than 700 free strollers; departing passengers who choose to check in their own stroller can collect one in boarding areas A and E, at gates A31 and A61 and at the escalators to gates E1–E4. Family Lane is a dedicated security lane for families with children and pregnant passengers. The airport has 4 baby rooms with cots and changing tables: behind check-in desks 312–327 in Terminal 3, in the shopping gallery in area A before gates A61–A83, and near E11 and E44. Food outlets can be asked to warm a bottle or baby food and sterilize a pacifier.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.hint: AIRPORT FREE WIFI, no time limit
wifi.text: The airport provides free Wi-Fi with no time limit. AIRPORT FREE WIFI is available in check-in, boarding gate and arrivals areas. Select the network and open a browser to connect: the device automatically redirects to the welcome page.
